title: RCT Comparing Avatar Intervention to Supportive Intervention to Reduce Cannabis Use in Patients With Psychotic Disorders
official: A Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Avatar Intervention to an Addiction Supportive Intervention to Reduce Cannabis Use in Patients With Psychotic Disorders
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to conduct a single-blind randomized controlled trial to verify whether the Avatar Intervention has greater efficacy over supportive intervention to reduce cannabis use in patients with psychotic disorders.
